aboutSection.desc1: EaseSign, a product of PT Paramita Digital Nusantara, delivers enterprise-grade document authentication platforms built for the rigorous demands of the modern economy.
aboutSection.desc2: We eliminate workflow bottlenecks by providing secure, legally compliant, and instantaneous digital signatures. Our mission is to empower teams to authenticate documents with absolute confidence and accelerate their digital transformation.

featureSection.title: Why choose EaseSign?
featureSection.subtitle: Experience a secure and legally-binding digital signature platform tailored for your modern business operations.

features.title: Efficiency and Productivity
features.description: Our tailored platform for digital signatures and stamps based customer needs will streamline document workflows, reducing the time and resources required for manual paperwork.

features.title: Enhanced Security Measures
features.description: Our company has employed advanced encryption techniques and authentication methods to safeguard digital documents against unauthorized access and fraud.

features.title: Government Support and Partnerships
features.description: Our company has received Electronic System Operator permit from Komdigi Ministry of Communications and Informatics. Our Platform is fully supported by PERURI and Directorate General of Taxes. The validity of the document is certainly guaranteed.

productsSection.title: Our Products
productsSection.subtitle: From legally-binding electronic signatures to military-grade identity verification, we provide everything you need to digitize your onboarding and operations.

signatureProducts.title: Easy Sign
signatureProducts.description: We offer an easy, secure and legally valid digital signature solution for our clients. Users can easily send, receive, and digitally authenticate and sign documents.

signatureProducts.title: Easy Stamp
signatureProducts.description: We offer Easy Stamp, an easy, secure, digital form of paper stamps used for electronic document purposes. E-Stamp is fully supported by PERURI (Indonesian Security Printing and Minting Corporation) and DJP (Directorate General of Taxes).

kycProducts.title: ID Card Documents OCR
kycProducts.description: Automate your KYC onboarding with AI-powered OCR to seamlessly extract and validate identity documents in real-time.

kycProducts.title: Face Verification
kycProducts.description: Ensure the person behind the screen is genuine with high-accuracy facial recognition that compares live selfies to ID photos.

kycProducts.title: Liveness Detection
kycProducts.description: Prevent spoofing and presentation attacks instantly with our advanced passive liveness detection algorithms.
